# Roadmap

Everything below is counted from this repository at version **0.2.0**, not maintained alongside it. If a capability ships, the table changes on the next commit, because the table is generated from the same file the capability map lives in.

**45 available now. 5 next. 3 later.** 31 FHIR R4 resource types served at the boundary. 2 languages.

## Available now

45 capabilities are in the current release.

**Clinical core**

- Patient registration, demographics
- Scheduling, flow board
- Encounters, clinical notes
- Problem list, allergies, medications
- Orders, specimens, results
- Immunisations
- Allergy screening at prescribing
- Duplicate therapy screening
- Vitals with growth percentiles
- Clinical decision support (CDS Hooks)
- Referral management

**Interoperability**

- FHIR R4 boundary
- SMART on FHIR discovery
- SMART app launch and token exchange
- X12 eligibility (270/271)
- X12 claims (837P), remittance (835), status (277), ack (999)
- Prior authorisation (278)
- Bulk FHIR export (`$export`)
- C-CDA generate and import
- HL7 v2 interfaces (ADT, ORU, ORM, VXU)
- Immunisation registry submission

**Prescribing**

- Prescription authoring, sign, cancel
- Safety screening before signing

**Revenue cycle**

- Charge capture, claims, payments, remittance, statements
- Eligibility checking
- Fee schedules, contract rates
- Sliding scale, self-pay discounts
- Collections and dunning

**Quality and compliance**

- Hash-chained audit log
- Row-level security
- Break-glass access
- eCQM / quality measures
- MIPS / promoting interoperability

**Platform**

- Authentication and identity
- Multi-tenant, multi-facility
- Roles and permissions
- Patient portal
- Forms engine
- Self-hosting, backup, restore, upgrade
- Assistant / agentic layer
- Document management and scanning
- DICOM / imaging
- Telehealth
- Internationalisation
- Inventory and dispensing

## Next

The interface is written and the implementation plugs into it. Each of these becomes available to a deployment the moment the content behind it is supplied, without a change to any screen.

| Capability                          | Area          | Where it plugs in                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Drug-drug interactions              | Clinical core | _Needs licensed content._ `MedicationSafetyPort` is the interface; `capabilities` tells the UI what was actually checked so an empty result never reads as a clean bill                                                                                  |
| Dose range, renal and weight dosing | Clinical core | _Needs licensed content_, same port                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Transmission to pharmacy            | Prescribing   | _Needs certification_ with a national prescription routing network. `packages/adapters` holds the eRx seam                                                                                                                                               |
| Formulary and benefit check         | Prescribing   | _Needs licensed content._ `checkFormulary` on the `ErxAdapter` contract, with a typed result carrying tier, prior-auth flag, copay and alternatives                                                                                                      |
| CPT and ICD-10 code sets            | Revenue cycle | _Needs licensed content_ - `packages/terminology` is bring-your-own by design, and `ops terminology verify` is the way in: it checks the manifest, the licence attestation and the payload hash before a row is written. See docs/terminology-loading.md |

## Later

These cannot be started inside this repository. Each needs an external body, and the reason is recorded rather than left as an empty cell.

| Capability                   | Area                   | State         | Reason                                                                                    |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Direct secure messaging      | Interoperability       | Missing       | _Needs certification_ - requires a HISP                                                   |
| Controlled substances (EPCS) | Prescribing            | Not startable | _Needs certification_ - DEA identity proofing, two-factor at signing, audited application |
| ONC certification            | Quality and compliance | Not startable | _Needs certification_ - a testing body, not a sprint                                      |

## Standards at the boundary
